_source: Crafting tree in the back yard (sprint 001, phase D, user brief 2026-11-25 items 3-7, 19-21). Demo Specification §2.3 had recipes OUT OF SCOPE; brought in by the user's sprint brief (see production/sprints/sprint-001.md). tree: the hollow tree piece (furniture.json kind crafting_tree) and how long E is held next to it to open the hollow (game minutes, like a search). slots: ingredient slots round the pentagram. start_tier: the tree's level at the start. upgrades: each next level of the tree, paid from the inventory (cost: item -> units), unlocks the recipes of that tier. recipes: id, result (item id in loot.json), amount made, tier (unlocked at that level), ingredients (item -> units; at most `slots` kinds), text (string key of the description). All numbers are provisional balance values.
